source_row.rationale: Psychological safety — a team environment in which members feel comfortable speaking up about concerns, asking questions, admitting mistakes, or offering ideas without fear of embarrassment or retribution — is associated in research with improved team performance, learning, innovation, and patient safety outcomes, an increasingly recognized and valued characteristic of high-functioning healthcare teams.
source_row.source_detail: Psychological Safety and Its Impact on Team Performance
source_row.source_name: Harvard Business School / AHRQ — Psychological Safety in Healthcare Teams
